title: Harbhajan Singh in Aap Ki Adalat 2016 (Full Episode)
description: Watch Team India star bowler Harbhajan Singh aka 'Bhajji' grilled by Rajat Sharma in Aap Ki Adalat. Harbhajan Singh said that his wife Geeta Basra is pregnant. Harbhajan speaks on selection of Anil Kumble as Team India coach.  Harbhajan said that it's wrong to criticize Anushka Sharma for poor performance of Virat Kohli. Harbhajan said that Pakistani players are not good in English and hilariously speak on Abdul Razzak and Inzamam-ul-Haq's English. Harbhajan speaks on MS Dhoni's captaincy and his face expression. Harbhajan reveals why he gets angry so quick and slapped Sreesanth and Ambati Rayudu. Harbhajan Singh reveals why he sledged and abused Australian players like Andrew Symonds, McGrath and Lehmen.
